The face has a very thick strange mouth, not horse-like." RimWorld creature sprite, ground-level side view (east), painterly vanilla-RimWorld animal art style: a bordok of Endor, the Ewoks' pack animal: a pony-sized stocky quadruped with a deep barrel and strong back, olive-tan to mustard-brown hide, two buffalo-like horns curving up and back, a dark red-brown mane, split dark hooves and pale lower legs. Its head is NOT a horse's: a heavy blunt head with a very thick, broad, fleshy, strange-looking mouth and muzzle, thick lips and a wide dark nose pad, like the bordok in the Ewoks comic. Single creature, centred, standing pose, whole body visible, no ground shadow, no background scenery.

Heavier and more spiked than the female. Never blue or purple, no tusks. Single creature, centred, standing pose, whole body visible, no ground shadow, no background scenery.
